question: What future beings arise even within the abyss of the hell-ocean?
premises: Beings are continually coming into existence.
Such arising occurs even in the lowest realms.
The hell-ocean abyss is included in this scope.
inference: Future beings likewise arise even in the depths of the hell-ocean.
uncertainties: The syntactic connection to surrounding verses is fragmentary.
plain_english: Likewise, beings yet to be born arise even in the abyss of the ocean of hell.
